Ministry of Electronics, and Information Technology, MeitY, has established India AI 
Independent Business Division (India AI) under Digital India Corporation for 
implementing the India AI mission. The India AI Mission aims to create a robust 
ecosystem that accelerates AI innovation through strategic initiatives and 
collaborations spanning both public and private domains. By democratizing access to 
computing resources, enhanc ing data quality, nurturing homegrown AI expertise, 
attracting top talent, fostering industry partnerships, supporting startup ventures, 
promoting socially impactful AI projects, and emphasizing ethical practices, the 
mission seeks to foster responsible an d inclusive growth within India’s AI landscape. 
Government of India has recently approved the IndiaAI Mission to democratize access 
to AI innovation pillars and ensure global competitiveness of India’s AI ecosystem 
catalyzing AI innovation through strategic programs and partnerships across the public 
and private sectors. By democratizing computing access, improving data quality, 
developing indigenous AI capabilities, attracting top AI talent, enabling industry 
collaboration, providing startup risk capital, ensuring socially impactful AI projects 
and bolstering ethical AI, it will drive responsible, inclusive growth of India’s AI 
ecosystem. 
India AI is currently inviting applications for the below position purely on Contract/ 
Consolidated basis. 
 
Sr.No Name of the Post No. of 
Positions 
1. General Manager - 
Finance 
1 
The place of posting shall be in Delhi/NCR but transferable to project locations of 
IndiaAI as per existing policy of IndiaAI. 
 
 
The details can be downloaded from the official website of DIC, NeGD & MeitY, 
viz. www.dic.gov.in, www.negd.gov.in,&www.meity.gov.in

About India AI 
The IndiaAI Mission aims to build a comprehensive ecosystem that fosters AI 
innovation by democratizing computing access, enhancing data quality, developing 
indigenous AI capabilities, attracting top AI talent, enabling industry collaboration, 
providing startup risk capital, ensuring socially impactful AI projects, and 
promoting ethical AI. This mission drives responsible and inclusive growth of India's 
AI ecosystem through following seven pillars. 
About DIC 
The Digital India Corporation (formerly Media Lab Asia) has been set up by the 
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India, 
to innovate, develop and deploy ICT and other emerging technologies for the 
benefit of the common man. Digital India Corporation plays the role of a leader in 
promoting e -Governance by taking forward the projects and activities of the  
Digital India Programme, to facilitate its stakeholders to realise its goals. It also 
provides strategic support to Ministries & Departments, both at the Central and 
State level for carrying forward the mission of the Digital India Programme by way 
of Capa city Building for e -Governance projects, promoting best practices, 
encouraging Public-Private Partnerships (PPP), nurturing innovation and technology 
in various domains. Digital India Corporation has several Independent Business 
Divisions under it and these include NeGD, MyGov, Bhashini, ISM, IndiaAI and MSH. 
More details can be seen at https://dic.gov.in/ 
 
GM – Finance 
 
Designation : GM -Finance 
Project : India AI 
Reporting to : COO, IndiaAI 
 
Roles & Responsibilities 
Financial Statements & Records 
 Ensure regular compilation of financial statements for IndiaAI 
 Ensure preparation of financial reports for projects being implemented by 
IndiaAI. 
 Compliance to statutory rules and regulations for all financial matters related 
to IndiaAI. 
 Maintenance of book of accounts viz. journal ,cash book, Petty cash ledger 
and subsidiaries 
 Preparation of P&L Accounts, Balance Sheet etc. 
 Processing of Salary, Employees monthly contribution payments and tax 
computation. 
 Filing of various tax returns after depositing same with concerned authorities 
and issue of TDS certificates. 
 Ensure compliance to statutory rules and regulations for all financial matters 
related to IndiaAI 
 
 
 
Funds Management 
 
 Disbursements of funds to different verticals/pillars & monitoring its 
expenditure . 
 Tracking of funds availability under various heads on monthly basis.. 
 Preparation of bank reconciliation statement. 
 Submission of UC's on Quarterly/ need basis in format as prescribed in GFR/ 
respective Grant Allocation 
 Issue & Submission of UC's to funding agencies/MeitY and coordination to 
reconcile Grant allocation 
 
 
Budgeting 
 
 Preparation of annual budget of IndiaAI . 
 
 
Bills and Expense Monitoring 
 
 Monitor the timely clearing of bills and payments in line with the established 
principles and guidelines. 
 
 Timely payments of salaries/allowances to IndiaAI employees. 
 
 
 
Coordination of Audit activity for internal, Statutory & CAG Audit, 
Including vendor Agencies Audit. 
 
 To facilitate the audits ensure to keep the accounts ready, make the 
vouchers available, Compile Schedules such as Funds Received During the 
Year, Assets Schedules, Balance Sheet, Income & Expenditure Account etc. 
 To process and respond to the audit queries, observations, comments and 
paras in coordination with respective verticals/ project owners 
 
 
B.  Education: 
 
 Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (Preferably B.Com) 
 Professional qualification such as CA/ICWA or similar will be considered a 
plus 
 
 
C. Desired Skills & Experience: 
 
 15 years of experience in diverse Finance & accounts in a large set up 
 Proven track record in strategic financial leadership roles. 
 Knowledge of Tally and other accounting software 
 Experience in diverse Finance & accounts in Government Departments/ 
Organizations is preferable 
 Knowledge of GFR & other financial rules of GOI, manual of office procedure 
would be added advantage 
 Knowledge of noting and drafting and is well acquainted with Govt. Rules & 
Regulations will be considered a plus 
 
General Conditions applicable to all applicants covered under this 
advertisement: 
 
▪ Those candidates, who are already in regular or contractual employment 
under Central / State Government, Public Sector Undertakings or 
Autonomous Bodies, are expected to apply through proper channel or attach 
a ‘No Objection Certificate’ from the employer concerned with the application 
OR produce No Objection Certificate at the time of interview. 
▪ IndiaAI reserves the right to fill all or some or none of the positions 
advertised without assigning any reason as it deems fit. 
▪ The positions are purely temporary in nature for the project of India AI and 
the appointees shall not derive any right or claim for permanent appointment 
at India AI or on any vacancies existing or that shall be advertised for 
recruitment by IndiaAI in future. 
▪ Screening of applications will be based on qualifications and relevant 
experience. IndiaAI reserves the right to fix higher threshold of qualifications 
and experience for screening and limiting the number of candidates for 
interview. 
▪ Only shortlisted candidates shall be invited for interviews. India AI reserves 
the right to not to select any of the candidates without assigning any reason 
thereof. 
▪ IndiaAI reserves the right to terminate the appointments of all positions with 
a notice of one month or without any notice by paying one month’s salary in 
lieu of the notice period. 
▪ The maximum age shall be as on the last date of receipt of the applications.

Job Description: Deputy Manager / Manager – Administration and Operations 
 
Designation: Deputy Manager / Manager – Administration and Operations 
Number of Positions: 1 
Location: Delhi NCR 
 
1. Job Purpose 
The Administration and Operations Expert will provide day -to-day administrative, operational, 
and coordination support across the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. The position 
will be responsible for maintaining programme documentation, facilitating administrative 
processes, supporting events and outreach activities, and assisting in the operational 
management of the national dashboard and Management Information System (MIS). 
2. Key Responsibilities 
 
• Provide day -to-day administrative and operational coordination across the various 
workstreams of the Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. 
• Facilitate internal coordination, administrative approvals, meeting arrangements, 
scheduling, and follow-up on action points. 
• Maintain programme records, official correspondence, project documentation, meeting 
minutes, trackers, and other administrative records. 
• Assist in preparing agendas, briefing notes, presentations, reports, and documentation 
required for internal reviews and stakeholder meetings. 
• Coordinate workshops, conferences, consultations, training programmes, outreach 
activities, and other programme -related events.  Ensure arrangement of  venue, all 
logistics requirement. Coordinate with media team to ensure branding/ outreach at venue  
• Provide operational support for stakeholder engagement activities involving government 
departments, academic institutions, implementation partners, and other agencies. 
• Support the operational administration of the national dashboard and MIS, including data 
coordination, updating records, tracking submissions, and following up with relevant 
stakeholders. 
• Coordinate with technical teams and programme stakeholders to ensure timely 
availability and accuracy of information required for dashboard updates and management 
reporting. 
• Monitor pending activities, maintain operational trackers, and follow up with concerned 
teams for timely completion of deliverables. Coordinate with states & it’s department for 
execution of activities. 
• Assist in collecting, compiling, validating, and consolidating programme information and 
periodic progress reports. 
• Support logistics, documentation, and other administrative requirements necessary for 
smooth functioning of the PMU. 
• Identify operational bottlenecks and escalate issues requiring intervention by programme 
leadership. 
• Ensure proper record management, information accuracy, and adherence to established 
administrative procedures. 
• Undertake other administrative and operational responsibilities assigned by the reporting 
officer. 
 
 
3. Essential Qualifications 
Either of the following: 
• Bachelor's degree in any discipline, with at least 5  - 6 years of relevant professional 
experience. 
4. Experience 
• Relevant experience in administration, operations, programme coordination, MIS 
management, documentation, or project support is desirable.  
• Experience in government projects, public -sector organizations, PMUs, or large -scale 
development programmes will be an advantage. 
• Experience in event management, venue & logistic coordination 
• Experience in drafting notes , preparing presentation, dashboard etc.

Job Description: Assistant Manager – Future Skills / AI Talent Mission 
 
Designation: Assistant Manager 
Number of Positions: 3 
Location : Delhi NCR 
 
1. Job Purpose 
The Assistant Manager will serve as a shared resource for the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and the 
AI Talent Mission, supporting programme implementation, administrative clearances, 
interdepartmental coordination, and execution of assigned key result areas (KRAs). The role will 
involve working closely with the designated Project Manager and relevant stakeholders to ensure 
timely execution of initiatives, effective monitoring of deliverables, and adherence to established 
procedures. 
 
2. Key Responsibilities 
 
• Support the implementation and coordination of schemes and initiatives under the 
IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. 
• Facilitate administrative approvals, internal clearances, file processing, and coordination 
with relevant divisions and government stakeholders. 
• Work under the guidance of the designated Project Manager to execute assigned projects, 
activities, and deliverables. 
• Drive individual KRAs and ensure timely achievement of assigned milestones and 
programme outcomes. 
• Coordinate with implementing agencies, academic institutions, training partners, 
government departments, and other stakeholders, as required. 
• Assist in preparing project proposals, implementation plans, progress reports, 
presentations, meeting briefs, and official correspondence. 
• Monitor project timelines, track pending actions, and follow up with concerned 
stakeholders to ensure timely completion of activities. 
• Maintain programme records, documentation, approval trails, and other relevant project 
information. 
• Support review meetings, stakeholder consultations, workshops, events, and other 
programme-related activities. 
• Identify implementation bottlenecks and escalate issues requiring managerial or 
administrative intervention. 
• Undertake any other responsibilities assigned by the competent authority in furtherance 
of the Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. 
3. Qualifications and Experience 
• The candidate should possess a relevant graduate or postgraduate qualification in 
management, public administration, engineering, technology, social sciences, or a related 
discipline.  
• 2+ relevant experience in project coordination, programme management, government 
initiatives, skilling, education, or technology-related programmes will be an advantage.

Job Description: Deputy Manager / Manager – Finance 
 
Designation: Deputy Manager / Manager – Finance 
Number of Positions: 1 
Functional Area: Financial Management, Budgeting and Program Finance 
Location : Delhi NCR 
 
1. Job Purpose 
The Finance Expert will be responsible for supporting financial planning, budgeting, expenditure 
monitoring, fund utilization, procurement-related financial processes, and financial reporting for 
initiatives under the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. The role will ensure 
financial discipline, compliance with applicable guidelines, and timely reporting to program 
leadership and relevant authorities. 
 
 
2. Key Responsibilities 
●       Prepare, consolidate, and monitor annual budgets, financial estimates, and expenditure    
plans for the AI Talent Mission and related Future Skills initiatives.  Ensure regular 
compilation of financial statements for  IndiaAI 
 
• Track budget utilization and expenditure across implementing partners, participating 
States, and other program stakeholders. 
• Review financial proposals, expenditure statements, utilization certificates, and 
supporting documents submitted by implementing agencies, as applicable. 
• Monitor fund releases, expenditure patterns, outstanding financial requirements, and 
budget variances, and recommend corrective measures where necessary. 
• Support procurement processes, financial evaluations, contract management, invoice 
verification, and vendor payment processing in coordination with the relevant teams. 
• Ensure compliance with applicable financial rules, organizational policies, approved 
budgets, contractual provisions, audit requirements, and statutory obligations. 
• Develop and maintain financial dashboards, budget trackers, and periodic utilization 
reports for program management and the Apex Steering Committee. 
• Coordinate with implementing agencies, auditors, finance divisions, and other 
stakeholders for financial reporting, reconciliation, and timely fund releases. 
• Assist in the preparation of financial inputs for project proposals, government 
submissions, review meetings, and management reports. 
• Maintain accurate financial records, supporting documentation, expenditure statements, 
and audit trails. 
• Identify financial risks, potential budget overruns, and utilization-related bottlenecks, and 
escalate issues to the appropriate authority. 
• Support internal and external audits and facilitate timely responses to audit observations 
and financial queries. 
• Coordinate with program and procurement teams to align financial planning with 
implementation schedules and contractual milestones. 
• Disbursements of funds to different verticals/pillars & monitoring its expenditure . 
Tracking of funds availability under various heads on monthly basis. 
 
• Preparation of bank reconciliation statement. 
 
• Submission of UC's on Quarterly/ need basis in format as prescribed in GFR/ respective 
Grant Allocation  
• Issue & Submission of UC's to funding agencies/MeitY and coordination to reconcile Grant 
allocation 
• Undertake any other finance-related responsibilities assigned by the competent authority. 
3. Essential Qualifications 
Graduate preferably (B.Com)/MBA in Finance, or an equivalent relevant qualification from a 
recognized institution.Candidates with knowledge on GFR and Government Procurement rules 
may be preferred. 
4. Experience 
• Minimum 5  - 6  years of relevant professional experience in financial management, 
budgeting, procurement, or program finance. 
• Experience working with public-sector, government, or social-sector organizations is 
preferred. 
• Knowledge of Tally & other accounting software 
• Experience in fund utilization monitoring, financial reporting, audit coordination, vendor 
payments, and contract-related financial processes will be an advantage. 
• Financial Planning & Management, including budgeting, expenditure tracking, fund 
utilisation and financial analysis. 
• Financial Reporting, Compliance & Risk Management, including reconciliation, audits, 
procurement and contract finance. 
• MIS & Stakeholder Coordination, including advanced MS Excel, financial reporting tools 
and coordination with government agencies and implementing partners.

effective outreach, stakeholder engagement, and visibility of program initiatives, achievements,

programme visibility and stakeholder engagement.

Job Description: Deputy Manager / Manager – Administration and Operations 
 
Designation: Deputy Manager / Manager – Administration and Operations 
Number of Positions: 1 
Location: Delhi NCR 
 
1. Job Purpose 
The Administration and Operations Expert will provide day -to-day administrative, operational, 
and coordination support across the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. The position 
will be responsible for maintaining programme documentation, facilitating administrative 
processes, supporting events and outreach activities, and assisting in the operational 
management of the national dashboard and Management Information System (MIS). 
2. Key Responsibilities 
 
• Provide day -to-day administrative and operational coordination across the various 
workstreams of the Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. 
• Facilitate internal coordination, administrative approvals, meeting arrangements, 
scheduling, and follow-up on action points. 
• Maintain programme records, official correspondence, project documentation, meeting 
minutes, trackers, and other administrative records. 
• Assist in preparing agendas, briefing notes, presentations, reports, and documentation 
required for internal reviews and stakeholder meetings. 
• Coordinate workshops, conferences, consultations, training programmes, outreach 
activities, and other programme -related events.  Ensure arrangement of  venue, all 
logistics requirement. Coordinate with media team to ensure branding/ outreach at venue  
• Provide operational support for stakeholder engagement activities involving government 
departments, academic institutions, implementation partners, and other agencies. 
• Support the operational administration of the national dashboard and MIS, including data 
coordination, updating records, tracking submissions, and following up with relevant 
stakeholders. 
• Coordinate with technical teams and programme stakeholders to ensure timely 
availability and accuracy of information required for dashboard updates and management 
reporting. 
• Monitor pending activities, maintain operational trackers, and follow up with concerned 
teams for timely completion of deliverables. Coordinate with states & it’s department for 
execution of activities. 
• Assist in collecting, compiling, validating, and consolidating programme information and 
periodic progress reports. 
• Support logistics, documentation, and other administrative requirements necessary for 
smooth functioning of the PMU. 
• Identify operational bottlenecks and escalate issues requiring intervention by programme 
leadership. 
• Ensure proper record management, information accuracy, and adherence to established 
administrative procedures. 
• Undertake other administrative and operational responsibilities assigned by the reporting 
officer. 
 
 
3. Essential Qualifications 
Either of the following: 
• Bachelor's degree in any discipline, with at least 5  - 6 years of relevant professional 
experience. 
4. Experience 
• Relevant experience in administration, operations, programme coordination, MIS 
management, documentation, or project support is desirable.  
• Experience in government projects, public -sector organizations, PMUs, or large -scale

• Experience in event management, venue & logistic coordination

Job Description: Deputy Manager / Manager – Finance 
 
Designation: Deputy Manager / Manager – Finance 
Number of Positions: 1 
Functional Area: Financial Management, Budgeting and Program Finance 
Location : Delhi NCR 
 
1. Job Purpose 
The Finance Expert will be responsible for supporting financial planning, budgeting, expenditure 
monitoring, fund utilization, procurement-related financial processes, and financial reporting for 
initiatives under the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. The role will ensure 
financial discipline, compliance with applicable guidelines, and timely reporting to program 
leadership and relevant authorities. 
 
 
2. Key Responsibilities 
●       Prepare, consolidate, and monitor annual budgets, financial estimates, and expenditure    
plans for the AI Talent Mission and related Future Skills initiatives.  Ensure regular 
compilation of financial statements for  IndiaAI 
 
• Track budget utilization and expenditure across implementing partners, participating 
States, and other program stakeholders. 
• Review financial proposals, expenditure statements, utilization certificates, and 
supporting documents submitted by implementing agencies, as applicable. 
• Monitor fund releases, expenditure patterns, outstanding financial requirements, and 
budget variances, and recommend corrective measures where necessary. 
• Support procurement processes, financial evaluations, contract management, invoice 
verification, and vendor payment processing in coordination with the relevant teams. 
• Ensure compliance with applicable financial rules, organizational policies, approved 
budgets, contractual provisions, audit requirements, and statutory obligations. 
• Develop and maintain financial dashboards, budget trackers, and periodic utilization 
reports for program management and the Apex Steering Committee. 
• Coordinate with implementing agencies, auditors, finance divisions, and other 
stakeholders for financial reporting, reconciliation, and timely fund releases. 
• Assist in the preparation of financial inputs for project proposals, government 
submissions, review meetings, and management reports. 
• Maintain accurate financial records, supporting documentation, expenditure statements, 
and audit trails. 
• Identify financial risks, potential budget overruns, and utilization-related bottlenecks, and 
escalate issues to the appropriate authority. 
• Support internal and external audits and facilitate timely responses to audit observations 
and financial queries. 
• Coordinate with program and procurement teams to align financial planning with 
implementation schedules and contractual milestones. 
• Disbursements of funds to different verticals/pillars & monitoring its expenditure . 
Tracking of funds availability under various heads on monthly basis. 
 
• Preparation of bank reconciliation statement. 
 
• Submission of UC's on Quarterly/ need basis in format as prescribed in GFR/ respective 
Grant Allocation  
• Issue & Submission of UC's to funding agencies/MeitY and coordination to reconcile Grant 
allocation 
• Undertake any other finance-related responsibilities assigned by the competent authority. 
3. Essential Qualifications 
Graduate preferably (B.Com)/MBA in Finance, or an equivalent relevant qualification from a 
recognized institution.Candidates with knowledge on GFR and Government Procurement rules 
may be preferred. 
4. Experience 
• Minimum 5  - 6  years of relevant professional experience in financial management, 
budgeting, procurement, or program finance. 
• Experience working with public-sector, government, or social-sector organizations is 
preferred. 
• Knowledge of Tally & other accounting software 
• Experience in fund utilization monitoring, financial reporting, audit coordination, vendor 
payments, and contract-related financial processes will be an advantage. 
• Financial Planning & Management, including budgeting, expenditure tracking, fund 
utilisation and financial analysis. 
• Financial Reporting, Compliance & Risk Management, including reconciliation, audits, 
procurement and contract finance. 
• MIS & Stakeholder Coordination, including advanced MS Excel, financial reporting tools 
and coordination with government agencies and implementing partners.

Designation: Manager / Deputy Manager – Communications 
Number of Positions: 1 
Functional Area: Strategic Communications, Outreach and Branding

1. Job Purpose 
The Communications Expert will support the planning and execution of the communication 
strategy for the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar, including the AI Talent Mission. The role will involve 
close coordination with the IndiaAI Communications team to ensure c onsistent messaging, 
effective outreach, stakeholder engagement, and visibility of program initiatives, achievements, 
and outcomes. 
2. Key Responsibilities 
 
• Develop and implement communication and outreach plans for initiatives under the 
Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission in coordination with the IndiaAI Communications 
team. 
• Prepare communication briefs, key messages, programme updates, press inputs, 
newsletters, website content, social media content, and other communication materials. 
• Coordinate the development of presentations, brochures, reports, case studies, success 
stories, infographics, and other programme-related communication assets. 
• Support digital outreach campaigns to increase awareness of AI skilling, talent 
development, educational initiatives, and related programme opportunities. 
• Coordinate with internal teams, government departments, academic institutions, 
implementation partners, and other stakeholders to gather information and communicate 
programme developments. 
• Ensure consistency of messaging, branding, and communication standards across 
programme materials and outreach activities. 
• Support the dissemination of programme  announcements, milestones, achievements, 
and impact stories through appropriate communication channels. 
• Assist in planning and executing communication activities for workshops, conferences, 
stakeholder consultations, events, and public outreach programmes. 
• Travel across the country for conducting the events 
• Track the reach and effectiveness of communication initiatives using relevant engagement 
metrics and performance indicators. 
• Prepare periodic communication reports and recommendations for improving 
programme visibility and stakeholder engagement. 
• Maintain an organized repository of communication materials, approved content, 
photographs, event records, and programme information. 
• Ensure that all external communication is reviewed and approved in accordance with 
organizational communication protocols. 
• Undertake any other communication-related responsibilities assigned by the competent 
authority. 
 
3. Essential Qualifications 
 
Postgraduate degree or MBA in Marketing, Mass Communication, Public Relations, Branding, 
Digital Media, or a related discipline from a recognized institution. 
4. Experience& Desired Skills 
• Minimum 5 - 6years of relevant professional experience in large-scale public campaigns, 
digital marketing, communications, public relations, or brand management. 
• Experience in education, skilling, technology, government outreach programmes, or 
public-sector initiatives is preferred. 
• Experience in developing communication strategies, managing multi-channel campaigns, 
and coordinating with multiple stakeholders. 
• Strategic Communication & Content Development, including editorial and presentation 
skills. 
• Digital Marketing, Outreach & Campaign Management, including performance 
monitoring and digital tools. 
• Public Relations, Brand Management & Stakeholder Coordination, including translating 
technical information into public-facing communication.

Equivalent Designation: Project Manager 3

1. Job Purpose 
The Deputy General Manager – Future Skills will support the General Manager in overseeing the 
operations, implementation, and coordination of the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar. The position will 
be responsible for supervising ,implementation, execution of partnership management , 
coordinating with key ministries and government stakeholders for the AI Talent Mission, and 
ensuring effective planning, monitoring, and execution of programme activities. 
2. Key Responsibilities 
• Oversee the roles, responsibilities, and deliverables of the two Partnerships Managers, 
ensuring alignment with programme objectives and timelines. 
 
• Support the General Manager in the overall planning, implementation, monitoring, and 
review of initiatives under the Future Skills Pillar. 
• Prepare Dashboard & concept notes /proposals etc 
• Coordinate with relevant Central Government ministries, State Governments, 
government institutions, and other stakeholders for the implementation of the AI Talent 
Mission. 
• Facilitate inter -ministerial coordination, stakeholder consultations, and resolution of 
operational issues affecting programme delivery. 
• Develop and monitor implementation plans, project milestones, performance indicators, 
and deliverables across assigned workstreams. 
• Review progress reports, identify gaps in execution, and recommend corrective measures 
to ensure timely achievement of programme outcomes. 
• Coordinate with internal IndiaAI divisions and external implementation partners to ensure 
alignment of activities and effective programme execution. 
• Support the preparation of strategic notes, presentations, review briefs, meeting agendas, 
and progress reports for senior management and government stakeholders. 
• Assist in identifying partnership opportunities with ministries, academic institutions, 
industry bodies, skilling organizations, and other relevant stakeholders. 
• Monitor action points arising from review meetings and ensure timely follow -up and 
closure by the concerned teams. 
• Support governance, reporting, and administrative processes related to the Future Skills 
Pillar and AI Talent Mission. 
• Undertake additional responsibilities assigned by the General Manager or competent 
authority. 
3. Essential Qualifications 
• MBA  or post graduate degree in policy, law , social studies  or related  field  from a 
recognized institution. 
4. Experience 
• Minimum 12 years of professional experience, preferably in government organizations or 
PPP-mode programmes across digital transformation, skilling, education or technology 
initiatives.

Designation: Deputy Manager / Manager – Administration and Operations 
Number of Positions: 1 
Location: Delhi NCR 
 
1. Job Purpose 
The Administration and Operations Expert will provide day -to-day administrative, operational, 
and coordination support across the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. The position 
will be responsible for maintaining programme documentation, facilitating administrative 
processes, supporting events and outreach activities, and assisting in the operational 
management of the national dashboard and Management Information System (MIS). 
2. Key Responsibilities 
 
• Provide day -to-day administrative and operational coordination across the various 
workstreams of the Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. 
• Facilitate internal coordination, administrative approvals, meeting arrangements, 
scheduling, and follow-up on action points. 
• Maintain programme records, official correspondence, project documentation, meeting 
minutes, trackers, and other administrative records. 
• Assist in preparing agendas, briefing notes, presentations, reports, and documentation 
required for internal reviews and stakeholder meetings. 
• Coordinate workshops, conferences, consultations, training programmes, outreach 
activities, and other programme -related events.  Ensure arrangement of  venue, all 
logistics requirement. Coordinate with media team to ensure branding/ outreach at venue  
• Provide operational support for stakeholder engagement activities involving government 
departments, academic institutions, implementation partners, and other agencies. 
• Support the operational administration of the national dashboard and MIS, including data 
coordination, updating records, tracking submissions, and following up with relevant 
stakeholders. 
• Coordinate with technical teams and programme stakeholders to ensure timely 
availability and accuracy of information required for dashboard updates and management 
reporting. 
• Monitor pending activities, maintain operational trackers, and follow up with concerned 
teams for timely completion of deliverables. Coordinate with states & it’s department for 
execution of activities. 
• Assist in collecting, compiling, validating, and consolidating programme information and 
periodic progress reports. 
• Support logistics, documentation, and other administrative requirements necessary for 
smooth functioning of the PMU. 
• Identify operational bottlenecks and escalate issues requiring intervention by programme 
leadership. 
• Ensure proper record management, information accuracy, and adherence to established 
administrative procedures. 
• Undertake other administrative and operational responsibilities assigned by the reporting 
officer.

Either of the following: 
• Bachelor's degree in any discipline, with at least 5  - 6 years of relevant professional

Job Description: Deputy Manager / Manager – Finance 
 
Designation: Deputy Manager / Manager – Finance 
Number of Positions: 1 
Functional Area: Financial Management, Budgeting and Program Finance 
Location : Delhi NCR 
 
1. Job Purpose 
The Finance Expert will be responsible for supporting financial planning, budgeting, expenditure 
monitoring, fund utilization, procurement-related financial processes, and financial reporting for 
initiatives under the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. The role will ensure 
financial discipline, compliance with applicable guidelines, and timely reporting to program 
leadership and relevant authorities. 
 
 
2. Key Responsibilities 
●       Prepare, consolidate, and monitor annual budgets, financial estimates, and expenditure    
plans for the AI Talent Mission and related Future Skills initiatives.  Ensure regular 
compilation of financial statements for  IndiaAI 
 
• Track budget utilization and expenditure across implementing partners, participating 
States, and other program stakeholders. 
• Review financial proposals, expenditure statements, utilization certificates, and 
supporting documents submitted by implementing agencies, as applicable. 
• Monitor fund releases, expenditure patterns, outstanding financial requirements, and 
budget variances, and recommend corrective measures where necessary. 
• Support procurement processes, financial evaluations, contract management, invoice 
verification, and vendor payment processing in coordination with the relevant teams. 
• Ensure compliance with applicable financial rules, organizational policies, approved 
budgets, contractual provisions, audit requirements, and statutory obligations. 
• Develop and maintain financial dashboards, budget trackers, and periodic utilization 
reports for program management and the Apex Steering Committee. 
• Coordinate with implementing agencies, auditors, finance divisions, and other 
stakeholders for financial reporting, reconciliation, and timely fund releases. 
• Assist in the preparation of financial inputs for project proposals, government 
submissions, review meetings, and management reports. 
• Maintain accurate financial records, supporting documentation, expenditure statements, 
and audit trails. 
• Identify financial risks, potential budget overruns, and utilization-related bottlenecks, and 
escalate issues to the appropriate authority. 
• Support internal and external audits and facilitate timely responses to audit observations 
and financial queries. 
• Coordinate with program and procurement teams to align financial planning with 
implementation schedules and contractual milestones. 
• Disbursements of funds to different verticals/pillars & monitoring its expenditure . 
Tracking of funds availability under various heads on monthly basis. 
 
• Preparation of bank reconciliation statement. 
 
• Submission of UC's on Quarterly/ need basis in format as prescribed in GFR/ respective 
Grant Allocation  
• Issue & Submission of UC's to funding agencies/MeitY and coordination to reconcile Grant 
allocation 
• Undertake any other finance-related responsibilities assigned by the competent authority. 
3. Essential Qualifications 
Graduate preferably (B.Com)/MBA in Finance, or an equivalent relevant qualification from a 
recognized institution.Candidates with knowledge on GFR and Government Procurement rules 
may be preferred. 
4. Experience 
• Minimum 5  - 6  years of relevant professional experience in financial management, 
budgeting, procurement, or program finance. 
• Experience working with public-sector, government, or social-sector organizations is 
preferred. 
• Knowledge of Tally & other accounting software 
• Experience in fund utilization monitoring, financial reporting, audit coordination, vendor 
payments, and contract-related financial processes will be an advantage. 
• Financial Planning & Management, including budgeting, expenditure tracking, fund 
utilisation and financial analysis. 
• Financial Reporting, Compliance & Risk Management, including reconciliation, audits, 
procurement and contract finance. 
• MIS & Stakeholder Coordination, including advanced MS Excel, financial reporting tools 
and coordination with government agencies and implementing partners.

Job Description: Deputy Manager / Manager – Administration and Operations 
 
Designation: Deputy Manager / Manager – Administration and Operations 
Number of Positions: 1 
Location: Delhi NCR 
 
1. Job Purpose 
The Administration and Operations Expert will provide day -to-day administrative, operational, 
and coordination support across the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. The position 
will be responsible for maintaining programme documentation, facilitating administrative 
processes, supporting events and outreach activities, and assisting in the operational 
management of the national dashboard and Management Information System (MIS). 
2. Key Responsibilities 
 
• Provide day -to-day administrative and operational coordination across the various 
workstreams of the Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. 
• Facilitate internal coordination, administrative approvals, meeting arrangements, 
scheduling, and follow-up on action points. 
• Maintain programme records, official correspondence, project documentation, meeting 
minutes, trackers, and other administrative records. 
• Assist in preparing agendas, briefing notes, presentations, reports, and documentation 
required for internal reviews and stakeholder meetings. 
• Coordinate workshops, conferences, consultations, training programmes, outreach 
activities, and other programme -related events.  Ensure arrangement of  venue, all 
logistics requirement. Coordinate with media team to ensure branding/ outreach at venue  
• Provide operational support for stakeholder engagement activities involving government 
departments, academic institutions, implementation partners, and other agencies. 
• Support the operational administration of the national dashboard and MIS, including data 
coordination, updating records, tracking submissions, and following up with relevant 
stakeholders. 
• Coordinate with technical teams and programme stakeholders to ensure timely 
availability and accuracy of information required for dashboard updates and management 
reporting. 
• Monitor pending activities, maintain operational trackers, and follow up with concerned 
teams for timely completion of deliverables. Coordinate with states & it’s department for 
execution of activities. 
• Assist in collecting, compiling, validating, and consolidating programme information and 
periodic progress reports. 
• Support logistics, documentation, and other administrative requirements necessary for 
smooth functioning of the PMU. 
• Identify operational bottlenecks and escalate issues requiring intervention by programme 
leadership. 
• Ensure proper record management, information accuracy, and adherence to established 
administrative procedures. 
• Undertake other administrative and operational responsibilities assigned by the reporting 
officer. 
 
 
3. Essential Qualifications 
Either of the following: 
• Bachelor's degree in any discipline, with at least 5  - 6 years of relevant professional 
experience. 
4. Experience 
• Relevant experience in administration, operations, programme coordination, MIS 
management, documentation, or project support is desirable.  
• Experience in government projects, public -sector organizations, PMUs, or large -scale 
development programmes will be an advantage. 
• Experience in event management, venue & logistic coordination 
• Experience in drafting notes , preparing presentation, dashboard etc.

Job Description: Assistant Manager – Future Skills / AI Talent Mission 
 
Designation: Assistant Manager 
Number of Positions: 3 
Location : Delhi NCR 
 
1. Job Purpose 
The Assistant Manager will serve as a shared resource for the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and the 
AI Talent Mission, supporting programme implementation, administrative clearances, 
interdepartmental coordination, and execution of assigned key result areas (KRAs). The role will 
involve working closely with the designated Project Manager and relevant stakeholders to ensure 
timely execution of initiatives, effective monitoring of deliverables, and adherence to established 
procedures. 
 
2. Key Responsibilities 
 
• Support the implementation and coordination of schemes and initiatives under the 
IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. 
• Facilitate administrative approvals, internal clearances, file processing, and coordination 
with relevant divisions and government stakeholders. 
• Work under the guidance of the designated Project Manager to execute assigned projects, 
activities, and deliverables. 
• Drive individual KRAs and ensure timely achievement of assigned milestones and 
programme outcomes. 
• Coordinate with implementing agencies, academic institutions, training partners, 
government departments, and other stakeholders, as required. 
• Assist in preparing project proposals, implementation plans, progress reports, 
presentations, meeting briefs, and official correspondence. 
• Monitor project timelines, track pending actions, and follow up with concerned 
stakeholders to ensure timely completion of activities. 
• Maintain programme records, documentation, approval trails, and other relevant project 
information. 
• Support review meetings, stakeholder consultations, workshops, events, and other 
programme-related activities. 
• Identify implementation bottlenecks and escalate issues requiring managerial or 
administrative intervention. 
• Undertake any other responsibilities assigned by the competent authority in furtherance 
of the Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. 
3. Qualifications and Experience 
• The candidate should possess a relevant graduate or postgraduate qualification in 
management, public administration, engineering, technology, social sciences, or a related 
discipline.  
• 2+ relevant experience in project coordination, programme management, government 
initiatives, skilling, education, or technology-related programmes will be an advantage.

Job Description: Deputy Manager / Manager – Finance 
 
Designation: Deputy Manager / Manager – Finance 
Number of Positions: 1 
Functional Area: Financial Management, Budgeting and Program Finance 
Location : Delhi NCR 
 
1. Job Purpose 
The Finance Expert will be responsible for supporting financial planning, budgeting, expenditure 
monitoring, fund utilization, procurement-related financial processes, and financial reporting for 
initiatives under the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. The role will ensure 
financial discipline, compliance with applicable guidelines, and timely reporting to program 
leadership and relevant authorities. 
 
 
2. Key Responsibilities 
●       Prepare, consolidate, and monitor annual budgets, financial estimates, and expenditure    
plans for the AI Talent Mission and related Future Skills initiatives.  Ensure regular 
compilation of financial statements for  IndiaAI 
 
• Track budget utilization and expenditure across implementing partners, participating 
States, and other program stakeholders. 
• Review financial proposals, expenditure statements, utilization certificates, and 
supporting documents submitted by implementing agencies, as applicable. 
• Monitor fund releases, expenditure patterns, outstanding financial requirements, and 
budget variances, and recommend corrective measures where necessary. 
• Support procurement processes, financial evaluations, contract management, invoice 
verification, and vendor payment processing in coordination with the relevant teams. 
• Ensure compliance with applicable financial rules, organizational policies, approved 
budgets, contractual provisions, audit requirements, and statutory obligations. 
• Develop and maintain financial dashboards, budget trackers, and periodic utilization 
reports for program management and the Apex Steering Committee. 
• Coordinate with implementing agencies, auditors, finance divisions, and other 
stakeholders for financial reporting, reconciliation, and timely fund releases. 
• Assist in the preparation of financial inputs for project proposals, government 
submissions, review meetings, and management reports. 
• Maintain accurate financial records, supporting documentation, expenditure statements, 
and audit trails. 
• Identify financial risks, potential budget overruns, and utilization-related bottlenecks, and 
escalate issues to the appropriate authority. 
• Support internal and external audits and facilitate timely responses to audit observations 
and financial queries. 
• Coordinate with program and procurement teams to align financial planning with 
implementation schedules and contractual milestones. 
• Disbursements of funds to different verticals/pillars & monitoring its expenditure . 
Tracking of funds availability under various heads on monthly basis. 
 
• Preparation of bank reconciliation statement. 
 
• Submission of UC's on Quarterly/ need basis in format as prescribed in GFR/ respective 
Grant Allocation  
• Issue & Submission of UC's to funding agencies/MeitY and coordination to reconcile Grant 
allocation 
• Undertake any other finance-related responsibilities assigned by the competent authority. 
3. Essential Qualifications 
Graduate preferably (B.Com)/MBA in Finance, or an equivalent relevant qualification from a 
recognized institution.Candidates with knowledge on GFR and Government Procurement rules 
may be preferred. 
4. Experience 
• Minimum 5  - 6  years of relevant professional experience in financial management, 
budgeting, procurement, or program finance. 
• Experience working with public-sector, government, or social-sector organizations is 
preferred. 
• Knowledge of Tally & other accounting software 
• Experience in fund utilization monitoring, financial reporting, audit coordination, vendor 
payments, and contract-related financial processes will be an advantage. 
• Financial Planning & Management, including budgeting, expenditure tracking, fund 
utilisation and financial analysis. 
• Financial Reporting, Compliance & Risk Management, including reconciliation, audits, 
procurement and contract finance. 
• MIS & Stakeholder Coordination, including advanced MS Excel, financial reporting tools 
and coordination with government agencies and implementing partners.

Designation: Manager / Deputy Manager – Communications

1. Job Purpose 
The Communications Expert will support the planning and execution of the communication 
strategy for the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar, including the AI Talent Mission. The role will involve 
close coordination with the IndiaAI Communications team to ensure c onsistent messaging, 
effective outreach, stakeholder engagement, and visibility of program initiatives, achievements, 
and outcomes. 
2. Key Responsibilities 
 
• Develop and implement communication and outreach plans for initiatives under the 
Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission in coordination with the IndiaAI Communications 
team. 
• Prepare communication briefs, key messages, programme updates, press inputs, 
newsletters, website content, social media content, and other communication materials. 
• Coordinate the development of presentations, brochures, reports, case studies, success 
stories, infographics, and other programme-related communication assets. 
• Support digital outreach campaigns to increase awareness of AI skilling, talent 
development, educational initiatives, and related programme opportunities. 
• Coordinate with internal teams, government departments, academic institutions, 
implementation partners, and other stakeholders to gather information and communicate 
programme developments. 
• Ensure consistency of messaging, branding, and communication standards across 
programme materials and outreach activities. 
• Support the dissemination of programme  announcements, milestones, achievements, 
and impact stories through appropriate communication channels. 
• Assist in planning and executing communication activities for workshops, conferences, 
stakeholder consultations, events, and public outreach programmes. 
• Travel across the country for conducting the events 
• Track the reach and effectiveness of communication initiatives using relevant engagement 
metrics and performance indicators. 
• Prepare periodic communication reports and recommendations for improving 
programme visibility and stakeholder engagement. 
• Maintain an organized repository of communication materials, approved content, 
photographs, event records, and programme information. 
• Ensure that all external communication is reviewed and approved in accordance with 
organizational communication protocols. 
• Undertake any other communication-related responsibilities assigned by the competent 
authority. 
 
3. Essential Qualifications 
 
Postgraduate degree or MBA in Marketing, Mass Communication, Public Relations, Branding, 
Digital Media, or a related discipline from a recognized institution. 
4. Experience& Desired Skills 
• Minimum 5 - 6years of relevant professional experience in large-scale public campaigns, 
digital marketing, communications, public relations, or brand management. 
• Experience in education, skilling, technology, government outreach programmes, or 
public-sector initiatives is preferred. 
• Experience in developing communication strategies, managing multi-channel campaigns, 
and coordinating with multiple stakeholders. 
• Strategic Communication & Content Development, including editorial and presentation 
skills. 
• Digital Marketing, Outreach & Campaign Management, including performance 
monitoring and digital tools. 
• Public Relations, Brand Management & Stakeholder Coordination, including translating 
technical information into public-facing communication.

1. Job Purpose 
The Deputy General Manager – Future Skills will support the General Manager in overseeing the 
operations, implementation, and coordination of the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar. The position will 
be responsible for supervising ,implementation, execution of partnership management , 
coordinating with key ministries and government stakeholders for the AI Talent Mission, and 
ensuring effective planning, monitoring, and execution of programme activities. 
2. Key Responsibilities 
• Oversee the roles, responsibilities, and deliverables of the two Partnerships Managers, 
ensuring alignment with programme objectives and timelines. 
 
• Support the General Manager in the overall planning, implementation, monitoring, and 
review of initiatives under the Future Skills Pillar. 
• Prepare Dashboard & concept notes /proposals etc 
• Coordinate with relevant Central Government ministries, State Governments, 
government institutions, and other stakeholders for the implementation of the AI Talent 
Mission. 
• Facilitate inter -ministerial coordination, stakeholder consultations, and resolution of 
operational issues affecting programme delivery. 
• Develop and monitor implementation plans, project milestones, performance indicators, 
and deliverables across assigned workstreams. 
• Review progress reports, identify gaps in execution, and recommend corrective measures 
to ensure timely achievement of programme outcomes. 
• Coordinate with internal IndiaAI divisions and external implementation partners to ensure 
alignment of activities and effective programme execution. 
• Support the preparation of strategic notes, presentations, review briefs, meeting agendas, 
and progress reports for senior management and government stakeholders. 
• Assist in identifying partnership opportunities with ministries, academic institutions, 
industry bodies, skilling organizations, and other relevant stakeholders. 
• Monitor action points arising from review meetings and ensure timely follow -up and 
closure by the concerned teams. 
• Support governance, reporting, and administrative processes related to the Future Skills 
Pillar and AI Talent Mission. 
• Undertake additional responsibilities assigned by the General Manager or competent 
authority. 
3. Essential Qualifications 
• MBA  or post graduate degree in policy, law , social studies  or related  field  from a 
recognized institution. 
4. Experience 
• Minimum 12 years of professional experience, preferably in government organizations or 
PPP-mode programmes across digital transformation, skilling, education or technology 
initiatives. 
 
• Programme Management & Strategic Execution, including implementation of large-scale 
initiatives, project monitoring and team leadership.

Job Description: Deputy Manager / Manager – Administration and Operations 
 
Designation: Deputy Manager / Manager – Administration and Operations 
Number of Positions: 1 
Location: Delhi NCR 
 
1. Job Purpose 
The Administration and Operations Expert will provide day -to-day administrative, operational, 
and coordination support across the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. The position 
will be responsible for maintaining programme documentation, facilitating administrative 
processes, supporting events and outreach activities, and assisting in the operational 
management of the national dashboard and Management Information System (MIS). 
2. Key Responsibilities 
 
• Provide day -to-day administrative and operational coordination across the various 
workstreams of the Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. 
• Facilitate internal coordination, administrative approvals, meeting arrangements, 
scheduling, and follow-up on action points. 
• Maintain programme records, official correspondence, project documentation, meeting 
minutes, trackers, and other administrative records. 
• Assist in preparing agendas, briefing notes, presentations, reports, and documentation 
required for internal reviews and stakeholder meetings. 
• Coordinate workshops, conferences, consultations, training programmes, outreach 
activities, and other programme -related events.  Ensure arrangement of  venue, all 
logistics requirement. Coordinate with media team to ensure branding/ outreach at venue  
• Provide operational support for stakeholder engagement activities involving government 
departments, academic institutions, implementation partners, and other agencies. 
• Support the operational administration of the national dashboard and MIS, including data 
coordination, updating records, tracking submissions, and following up with relevant 
stakeholders. 
• Coordinate with technical teams and programme stakeholders to ensure timely 
availability and accuracy of information required for dashboard updates and management 
reporting. 
• Monitor pending activities, maintain operational trackers, and follow up with concerned 
teams for timely completion of deliverables. Coordinate with states & it’s department for 
execution of activities. 
• Assist in collecting, compiling, validating, and consolidating programme information and 
periodic progress reports. 
• Support logistics, documentation, and other administrative requirements necessary for 
smooth functioning of the PMU. 
• Identify operational bottlenecks and escalate issues requiring intervention by programme 
leadership. 
• Ensure proper record management, information accuracy, and adherence to established 
administrative procedures. 
• Undertake other administrative and operational responsibilities assigned by the reporting 
officer. 
 
 
3. Essential Qualifications 
Either of the following: 
• Bachelor's degree in any discipline, with at least 5  - 6 years of relevant professional 
experience. 
4. Experience 
• Relevant experience in administration, operations, programme coordination, MIS 
management, documentation, or project support is desirable.  
• Experience in government projects, public -sector organizations, PMUs, or large -scale 
development programmes will be an advantage. 
• Experience in event management, venue & logistic coordination 
• Experience in drafting notes , preparing presentation, dashboard etc.

Designation: Assistant Manager 
Number of Positions: 3 
Location : Delhi NCR 
 
1. Job Purpose 
The Assistant Manager will serve as a shared resource for the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and the 
AI Talent Mission, supporting programme implementation, administrative clearances, 
interdepartmental coordination, and execution of assigned key result areas (KRAs). The role will 
involve working closely with the designated Project Manager and relevant stakeholders to ensure 
timely execution of initiatives, effective monitoring of deliverables, and adherence to established 
procedures. 
 
2. Key Responsibilities 
 
• Support the implementation and coordination of schemes and initiatives under the 
IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. 
• Facilitate administrative approvals, internal clearances, file processing, and coordination 
with relevant divisions and government stakeholders. 
• Work under the guidance of the designated Project Manager to execute assigned projects,

• Drive individual KRAs and ensure timely achievement of assigned milestones and

• Monitor project timelines, track pending actions, and follow up with concerned

• Maintain programme records, documentation, approval trails, and other relevant project

• Support review meetings, stakeholder consultations, workshops, events, and other 
programme-related activities. 
• Identify implementation bottlenecks and escalate issues requiring managerial or 
administrative intervention. 
• Undertake any other responsibilities assigned by the competent authority in furtherance

management, public administration, engineering, technology, social sciences, or a related

Job Description: Deputy Manager / Manager – Finance 
 
Designation: Deputy Manager / Manager – Finance 
Number of Positions: 1 
Functional Area: Financial Management, Budgeting and Program Finance 
Location : Delhi NCR 
 
1. Job Purpose 
The Finance Expert will be responsible for supporting financial planning, budgeting, expenditure 
monitoring, fund utilization, procurement-related financial processes, and financial reporting for 
initiatives under the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission. The role will ensure 
financial discipline, compliance with applicable guidelines, and timely reporting to program 
leadership and relevant authorities. 
 
 
2. Key Responsibilities 
●       Prepare, consolidate, and monitor annual budgets, financial estimates, and expenditure    
plans for the AI Talent Mission and related Future Skills initiatives.  Ensure regular 
compilation of financial statements for  IndiaAI 
 
• Track budget utilization and expenditure across implementing partners, participating 
States, and other program stakeholders. 
• Review financial proposals, expenditure statements, utilization certificates, and 
supporting documents submitted by implementing agencies, as applicable. 
• Monitor fund releases, expenditure patterns, outstanding financial requirements, and 
budget variances, and recommend corrective measures where necessary. 
• Support procurement processes, financial evaluations, contract management, invoice 
verification, and vendor payment processing in coordination with the relevant teams. 
• Ensure compliance with applicable financial rules, organizational policies, approved 
budgets, contractual provisions, audit requirements, and statutory obligations. 
• Develop and maintain financial dashboards, budget trackers, and periodic utilization 
reports for program management and the Apex Steering Committee. 
• Coordinate with implementing agencies, auditors, finance divisions, and other 
stakeholders for financial reporting, reconciliation, and timely fund releases. 
• Assist in the preparation of financial inputs for project proposals, government 
submissions, review meetings, and management reports. 
• Maintain accurate financial records, supporting documentation, expenditure statements, 
and audit trails. 
• Identify financial risks, potential budget overruns, and utilization-related bottlenecks, and 
escalate issues to the appropriate authority. 
• Support internal and external audits and facilitate timely responses to audit observations 
and financial queries. 
• Coordinate with program and procurement teams to align financial planning with 
implementation schedules and contractual milestones. 
• Disbursements of funds to different verticals/pillars & monitoring its expenditure . 
Tracking of funds availability under various heads on monthly basis. 
 
• Preparation of bank reconciliation statement. 
 
• Submission of UC's on Quarterly/ need basis in format as prescribed in GFR/ respective 
Grant Allocation  
• Issue & Submission of UC's to funding agencies/MeitY and coordination to reconcile Grant 
allocation 
• Undertake any other finance-related responsibilities assigned by the competent authority. 
3. Essential Qualifications 
Graduate preferably (B.Com)/MBA in Finance, or an equivalent relevant qualification from a 
recognized institution.Candidates with knowledge on GFR and Government Procurement rules 
may be preferred. 
4. Experience 
• Minimum 5  - 6  years of relevant professional experience in financial management, 
budgeting, procurement, or program finance. 
• Experience working with public-sector, government, or social-sector organizations is 
preferred. 
• Knowledge of Tally & other accounting software 
• Experience in fund utilization monitoring, financial reporting, audit coordination, vendor 
payments, and contract-related financial processes will be an advantage. 
• Financial Planning & Management, including budgeting, expenditure tracking, fund 
utilisation and financial analysis. 
• Financial Reporting, Compliance & Risk Management, including reconciliation, audits, 
procurement and contract finance. 
• MIS & Stakeholder Coordination, including advanced MS Excel, financial reporting tools 
and coordination with government agencies and implementing partners.

Job Description: Manager / Deputy Manager – Communications 
 
Designation: Manager / Deputy Manager – Communications 
Number of Positions: 1 
Functional Area: Strategic Communications, Outreach and Branding 
Location:Delhi/ NCR 
 
1. Job Purpose 
The Communications Expert will support the planning and execution of the communication 
strategy for the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar, including the AI Talent Mission. The role will involve 
close coordination with the IndiaAI Communications team to ensure c onsistent messaging, 
effective outreach, stakeholder engagement, and visibility of program initiatives, achievements, 
and outcomes. 
2. Key Responsibilities 
 
• Develop and implement communication and outreach plans for initiatives under the 
Future Skills Pillar and AI Talent Mission in coordination with the IndiaAI Communications 
team. 
• Prepare communication briefs, key messages, programme updates, press inputs, 
newsletters, website content, social media content, and other communication materials. 
• Coordinate the development of presentations, brochures, reports, case studies, success 
stories, infographics, and other programme-related communication assets. 
• Support digital outreach campaigns to increase awareness of AI skilling, talent 
development, educational initiatives, and related programme opportunities. 
• Coordinate with internal teams, government departments, academic institutions, 
implementation partners, and other stakeholders to gather information and communicate 
programme developments. 
• Ensure consistency of messaging, branding, and communication standards across 
programme materials and outreach activities. 
• Support the dissemination of programme  announcements, milestones, achievements, 
and impact stories through appropriate communication channels. 
• Assist in planning and executing communication activities for workshops, conferences, 
stakeholder consultations, events, and public outreach programmes. 
• Travel across the country for conducting the events 
• Track the reach and effectiveness of communication initiatives using relevant engagement 
metrics and performance indicators. 
• Prepare periodic communication reports and recommendations for improving 
programme visibility and stakeholder engagement. 
• Maintain an organized repository of communication materials, approved content, 
photographs, event records, and programme information. 
• Ensure that all external communication is reviewed and approved in accordance with 
organizational communication protocols. 
• Undertake any other communication-related responsibilities assigned by the competent 
authority. 
 
3. Essential Qualifications 
 
Postgraduate degree or MBA in Marketing, Mass Communication, Public Relations, Branding, 
Digital Media, or a related discipline from a recognized institution. 
4. Experience& Desired Skills 
• Minimum 5 - 6years of relevant professional experience in large-scale public campaigns, 
digital marketing, communications, public relations, or brand management. 
• Experience in education, skilling, technology, government outreach programmes, or 
public-sector initiatives is preferred. 
• Experience in developing communication strategies, managing multi-channel campaigns, 
and coordinating with multiple stakeholders. 
• Strategic Communication & Content Development, including editorial and presentation 
skills. 
• Digital Marketing, Outreach & Campaign Management, including performance 
monitoring and digital tools. 
• Public Relations, Brand Management & Stakeholder Coordination, including translating 
technical information into public-facing communication.

Job Description: Deputy General Manager – Future Skills 
 
Designation: Deputy General Manager – Future Skills 
Equivalent Designation: Project Manager 3 
Number of Positions: 1 
Functional Area: Future Skills and AI Talent Mission 
Location: Delhi NCR 
 
1. Job Purpose 
The Deputy General Manager – Future Skills will support the General Manager in overseeing the 
operations, implementation, and coordination of the IndiaAI Future Skills Pillar. The position will 
be responsible for supervising ,implementation, execution of partnership management , 
coordinating with key ministries and government stakeholders for the AI Talent Mission, and 
ensuring effective planning, monitoring, and execution of programme activities. 
2. Key Responsibilities 
• Oversee the roles, responsibilities, and deliverables of the two Partnerships Managers, 
ensuring alignment with programme objectives and timelines. 
 
• Support the General Manager in the overall planning, implementation, monitoring, and 
review of initiatives under the Future Skills Pillar. 
• Prepare Dashboard & concept notes /proposals etc 
• Coordinate with relevant Central Government ministries, State Governments, 
government institutions, and other stakeholders for the implementation of the AI Talent 
Mission. 
• Facilitate inter -ministerial coordination, stakeholder consultations, and resolution of 
operational issues affecting programme delivery. 
• Develop and monitor implementation plans, project milestones, performance indicators, 
and deliverables across assigned workstreams. 
• Review progress reports, identify gaps in execution, and recommend corrective measures 
to ensure timely achievement of programme outcomes. 
• Coordinate with internal IndiaAI divisions and external implementation partners to ensure 
alignment of activities and effective programme execution. 
• Support the preparation of strategic notes, presentations, review briefs, meeting agendas, 
and progress reports for senior management and government stakeholders. 
• Assist in identifying partnership opportunities with ministries, academic institutions, 
industry bodies, skilling organizations, and other relevant stakeholders. 
• Monitor action points arising from review meetings and ensure timely follow -up and 
closure by the concerned teams. 
• Support governance, reporting, and administrative processes related to the Future Skills 
Pillar and AI Talent Mission. 
• Undertake additional responsibilities assigned by the General Manager or competent 
authority. 
3. Essential Qualifications 
• MBA  or post graduate degree in policy, law , social studies  or related  field  from a 
recognized institution. 
4. Experience 
• Minimum 12 years of professional experience, preferably in government organizations or 
PPP-mode programmes across digital transformation, skilling, education or technology 
initiatives. 
 
• Programme Management & Strategic Execution, including implementation of large-scale 
initiatives, project monitoring and team leadership. 
• Experience of working in Govt sector / Departments/ Organizations

partnership management, analytical thinking, decision-making and communication skills.

DEPARTMENT OF ANATOMY 
ALL INDIA INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES GUWAHATI 
INFORMATION FOR THE PROSPECTIVE DONORS OF WHOLE-BODY AFTER DEATH 
1. AIIMS, Guwahati accepts donation of body after death for teaching and scientific research. 
2. People willing to donate their body after death must discuss about their wish with their immediate family, 
doctors, and other relevant people, before making the decision. 
3. The WILL FORM  can be obtained from the website of AIIMS, Guwahati  or directly from the 
Department of Anatomy, AIIMS, Guwahati located on the ground floor of college building.   
4. The WILL FORM duly filled by the donor should be returned to the office of  Department of Anatomy, 
AIIMS, Guwahati, for registration. 
5. Donor Card will be issued to the donor after registration.  
6. Documents to be submitted at the time of registration of WILL FORM 
a. Duly filled WILL FORM along with the consent of next of Kin (near relative). 
b. A passport size photograph. 
c. Identify proof (with address) of the donor (Voter card/Aadhar card).  
7. UNREGISTERED DONATIONS will also be accepted by the Department of Anatomy. 
8. After the death of the donor, it is the responsibility of the relatives of the deceased (donor) to inform the 
Department of Anatomy, AIIMS, Guwahati, about the death and discuss the procedure of donation with the 
faculty of Department of Anatomy. 
CONTACT DETAILS: 
 
Faculty  9864063237 (Dr Roonmoni Deka) 
9943540541 (Dr Praveen K) 
8289024121 (Dr Amandeep Kaur) 
Timings 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM (MONDAY to FRIDAY) 
9:00 AM – 12:30 PM (SATURDAY) 
 
9. If the body is accepted for donation, then the family members of the deceased are requested to bring the 
body to AIIMS Guwahati. 
10. Please note that the donation of the body MAY NOT BE ACCEPTED, if the donor has the following 
conditions: HIV, infective hepatitis, active tuberculosis, sepsis, gas gangrene, tetanus infection, putrefied 
bodies, COVID-19 positive, body after road traffic accident, medico-legal case or any other form of unnatural 
death. Such bodies are a serious health hazard to the medical students and the staff handling them. 
 
11. It is requested that any relative/friend of the deceased discuss the matter with the faculty from Department 
of Anatomy, at the time of death. After the faculty is satisfied with the information about the cause of death 
and the condition of the body etc., the donation will be accepted. 
12. Documents to be submitted at the time of handing over the body by the legal heir / near relatives/next 
of kin. (Registered donors and Unregistered donors) 
a. A copy of Certificate of Medical cause of death (Death certificate) by registered medical practitioner. 
b. No objection certificate from the local police station, regarding body donation to the medical college. 
c. Identity proof of the deceased donor (Voter ID / Aadhar card).  
d. Consent and Identify proof (Voter ID / Aadhar card) of legal heirs/near relatives of the deceased, who 
are present at the time of hand over of body to the Department of Anatomy. 
13. The dead body should be brought to the Department of Anatomy during above mentioned timings. The 
information of death should be shared with the Department of Anatomy, as early as possible, so that the 
Department can make necessary arrangements for further processing of the body. We request the relatives to 
make necessary arrangements to bring the body to the Department of Anatomy. 
14. The body may either be used immediately or preserved for variable periods of time for future use. After 
full utilization, the remains will be scientifically disposed. 
 
 
 
 
  
    Department of Anatomy
